Hi Jonas —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’d like to lock a 2.5 hour activation run the week of Aug 30 to validate prompt routing and run a short load sweep with a synthetic mix from our production queue.

Preferable windows: Tue Aug 31 10:00–12:30 PT or Thu Sep 2 09:00–11:30 PT.

I attached a short manifest (acme_sample_manifest.csv) showing a representative set of prompts and metadata. We scrubbed PII but left some contextual fields for intent routing tests. Please let us know if the format looks ok and if you need a separate upload mechanism (S3, Drive link, or secure upload).

Best,

Sophie — thanks for the manifest and the proposed windows. Tue Aug 31 10:00–12:30 PT works for us; I’ve tentatively blocked it on our side.

Quick plan and asks from Redwood: 
- Agenda (attached activation_agenda_v1.pdf): 5m intros, 25m prompt/rewrite review, 30m routing & policy tests, 30m scaled load sweep (up to 200 reqs/min), 20m evaluation checklist and redaction verification, 10m next steps.
- Please confirm whether the sample rows include any nested user-provided documents (we saw a doc_url column) — if yes, provide the storage location and access.
- We’ve attached our redaction_checklist.txt; during the session Ben will run a focused verification pass while I orchestrate the load window.
- Preferred upload: secure S3 presigned link (we can accept Drive but S3 is faster for our tooling). If ACME prefers Drive, we’ll pull from there.

Ben — are you ok to own redaction verification and the routing test scripts? Monica — can you draft the brief eval rubric I can share with Sophie before Tue?

Jonas
